svg.title: Residuals on the test data
svg.desc: The raw load_diabetes inputs use scaled=False. A default LinearRegression is fitted on 353 training rows after train_test_split with test_size=0.2 and random_state=42. Each of the 89 points pairs a test prediction with residual truth minus prediction. The highlighted first test row is original row 287: truth 219, prediction 139.547558, residual +79.452442. Positive residuals indicate underprediction; negative residuals indicate overprediction.
